description: This file defines the structure and loading logic for plugin manifests in the openclaw project, including types, constants, and functions for parsing, normalizing, and resolving plugin manifest data.

methods.name: normalizeStringList
methods.description: Normalizes an input value into a list of trimmed, non-empty strings.

methods.name: normalizeStringListRecord
methods.description: Normalizes an object record with string keys and list of strings as values.

methods.name: normalizeManifestContracts
methods.description: Normalizes contract-related fields in a plugin manifest into a structured object.

methods.name: normalizeManifestModelSupport
methods.description: Normalizes model support fields in a plugin manifest.

methods.name: normalizeProviderAuthChoices
methods.description: Normalizes provider authentication choices array in a plugin manifest.

methods.name: normalizeChannelConfigs
methods.description: Normalizes channel configuration objects in a plugin manifest.

methods.name: resolvePluginManifestPath
methods.description: Resolves the plugin manifest file path within a root directory.

methods.name: parsePluginKind
methods.description: Parses the plugin kind from raw input, supporting string or array formats.

methods.name: loadPluginManifest
methods.description: Loads and parses a plugin manifest from the filesystem, returning structured data or errors.

methods.name: getPackageManifestMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves openclaw-specific metadata from a package manifest.

methods.name: resolvePackageExtensionEntries
methods.description: Resolves extension entries from a package manifest, indicating if missing or empty.
